messages:
alex: Quick ask 1 - we need a customer-facing one-pager for onboarding that focuses on caching, batching, and streaming. Keep it short and actionable to reduce early churn from token surprises and latency. Drop practical snippets and checks.

priya: Agreed. My practical recommendations to include: 1) edge cache TTL = 30s for conversational completions, 2) client-side micro-batching for bursty UIs (batch size 3-8), 3) prefer streaming for chat to improve perceived latency.

sam: Add a "validation harness" customers can run to sanity-check perf + cost. Example: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"sanity-check","max_tokens":64}'` run 10x and capture median latency + token count.

jordan: For renewal health signals, keep a 3-metric dashboard: cache hit %, median token cost/session, streaming fallback rate. If cache hit < 10% after 7 days, flag for CS follow-up.

priya: Customer phrasing: "Pro tip: pre-warm frequent prompts with a low-priority daily job instead of relying on live traffic." Include an ops-safe curl snippet for pre-warm.

sam: Short JS batching example to include:
```
// client-batcher (concept)
let q=[]
function flush(){
 const b=q.splice(0,8)
 fetch('/api/generate',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(b)})
}
setInterval(flush,50) // tune by p95 SLA
```
Tune interval to hit latency objective.

alex: Also recommend a streaming safety net: if stream stalls >300ms, switch to a non-stream fallback with a limited token budget to avoid hangs.

jordan: Troubleshooting checklist to give customers: pin model variant, verify prefix caching uses exact tokenization, check routing policy if requests reroute to fallback region.

priya: For renewal conversations, CS should ask: "Have you seen unexplained token cost spikes?" If yes, run the validation harness and compare prompt distribution. Provide a pre-canned support path: 24h triage, 72h mitigation plan.

sam: Feedback capture suggestions: show an inline "was this helpful?" after stream, log anonymized prompt head (first 3 tokens) for debugging, surface top 5 failing prompts weekly to product.

alex: Can we assemble into a one-pager (customer language + 3 runnable snippets + 3 renewal metrics) by EOD? I'll add to onboarding kit and kickoff templates.

jordan: I'll draft the dashboard queries and sample Grafana metrics.

priya: I'll write the one-pager copy and the pre-warm curl snippet.

sam: I'll tidy code snippets and prepare the validation harness script.

cs-bot: Reminder: create Drive doc "CS Onboard  caching/batching/streaming checklist" and add reviewers: priya, sam, jordan, alex.

alex: Thanks team. Once live, we'll mark medium renewal-risk accounts as recommended recipients for a week-2 proactive health check. :thumbsup:
